verdict.rationale: Evidence shows OpenHands is built as an autonomous coding agent (CLI natural-language tasks, auto-approve mode, SDK for building code-working agents, custom tool system, quality/success scoring) which supports end-to-end feature implementation, but no evidence explicitly confirms it writes or runs tests as part of that workflow. missing for 10: explicit documentation/demo of test-writing as part of feature implementation, independent hands-on verification of end-to-end feature delivery.
